bento.title: What is Tallaby?
bento.lead: A platform to build an online store under your own brand and run it yourself, with no code.

platform.title: All-in-one platform
platform.body: Your store, products, orders, payments, shipping and marketing, in one dashboard.

support.title: 24/7 customer support
support.body: Message us on WhatsApp whenever you need us, and we'll help you set up and run your store.

marketers.title: Certified marketers for sellers
marketers.body: We connect you with Tallaby-certified marketers who help with your ads and growth.

world.title: Sell in Egypt and abroad
world.body: Choose your store's currency and the countries you ship to.

marketing.title: Bring customers back
marketing.body: Email campaigns, discount codes, and WhatsApp follow-up on unfinished orders.

import.title: Bring your products in minutes
import.body: From Excel, from a product link, or straight from Shopify.

ads.title: Ads that measure right
ads.body: Meta Pixel and Conversions API, GA4 and GTM, plus product feeds for Meta and Google.

domain.title: A store with your name on it
domain.body: Your logo and colours, at <domain>yourbrand.tallaby.com</domain> or on a domain you own.

mock.supportAsk: How do I connect my domain?
mock.shipTo: Ship to the countries you choose

steps.title: Create your store in 3 minutes
steps.lead: Three steps, no technical skills needed.

one.title: Sign up free
one.body: With Google or your email, then claim your store link.

two.title: Pick a template, add products with AI
two.body: Upload a photo and write a few words. Tallaby AI writes the title and description in Arabic and English.

three.title: Connect shipping and payments
three.body: Ship with Bosta, your own riders or a Wassalha sheet, and get paid through Tallaby Pay, Paymob, Kashier or cash on delivery.
three.bodyNoPay: Ship with Bosta, your own riders or a Wassalha sheet, and get paid through Paymob, Kashier or cash on delivery.

pay.title: Tallaby Pay: online payments with no gateway account
pay.lead: Turn it on in your store in one step, with no payment company account or keys.

points.methods: Customers pay by card, mobile wallet or Meeza, in cash at Fawry and Aman, or in instalments.
points.release: Your money is available once the order is delivered. Withdraw it to InstaPay, a bank account or a mobile wallet.
points.egp: For stores selling in EGP. Verify your ID once before your first withdrawal.

builder.title: Design your store with AI or drag and drop
builder.lead: Start from a short description or a ready template, then edit any section yourself.

ai.title: Tallaby AI builds your store
ai.body: Describe your store in a line. It suggests three templates and builds your store with copy, products and shipping policies.

dnd.title: Drag & Drop editor
dnd.body: Drag sections into order and change any text, photo or colour.

publish.title: Publish when you're ready
publish.body: Your changes stay a draft. Your live store changes only when you publish.

mock.prompt: A luxury oriental perfume store called Misk

customers.title: Features your customers notice
customers.lead: Tools that protect your orders and make buying from your store easier.

deposit.title: Deposit on cash orders
deposit.body: On cash on delivery orders, ask for 10%, 20%, 30% or 50% up front, paid straight to you.

confirm.title: Automatic order confirmation
confirm.body: Your customer gets an email confirming the order right away, and shipping and delivery updates with the Order notifications app.

record.title: Customer delivery rate
record.body: See, for each phone number, how many orders were received or refused in your store before you ship.

app.title: Your store app on their phone
app.body: Customers add your store to their home screen with your name and logo, and come back in one tap.

account.title: Customer account and wallet
account.body: Customers sign in to your store, follow their orders and pay from their Tallaby wallet, in full or in part.

more.title: And more
more.body: Fake order protection, phone blocking, unfinished orders, discount codes and reviews.

ai.title: AI that works for your store
ai.lead: Tools that save you time adding products, designing your store and running it.

assistant.title: An AI assistant for your store
assistant.body: Connect <claude>Claude</claude> or <chatgpt>ChatGPT</chatgpt> to your account once. Then ask it to add products or change prices, and it does it in your store.

product.title: Add products with AI
product.body: From a photo or a few lines: title and description in Arabic and English, with category and SEO.

design.title: Design your store with AI
design.body: Describe your store and Tallaby AI builds a full store from a template that fits it.

review.title: Store review
review.body: A report on what your store is missing and how to sell more.

blog.title: Write your blog posts
blog.body: Posts for your store's blog that help customers find you on Google.

mock.prompt: A store for cotton kids' clothes

apps.title: Apps that add what your store needs
apps.lead: Turn on what you need from your dashboard, and turn it off any time.
apps.cost: Each app's cost is shown in your dashboard before you turn it on.

items.tallaby_pay: Online payments with no gateway account. Withdraw your earnings to your account.
items.ai_assistants: Manage your products by chatting with Claude or ChatGPT.
items.bosta: Ship with Bosta in one click, with tracking updates.
items.customer_notifications: Emails your customer when the order ships, arrives or is cancelled.
items.easykash: Cards, wallets, Fawry and Aman, paid to your own EasyKash account.
items.google_analytics: Your store's traffic and sales in Google Analytics.
items.google_sheets: Export your orders to a spreadsheet.
items.google_tag_manager: Manage your tags from one GTM container.
items.kashier: Card and wallet payments to your own Kashier account.
items.meta_pixel: Track your Facebook and Instagram ads, with Conversions API.
items.tiktok_pixel: Measure your TikTok ads from your store's visits and orders.
items.snapchat_pixel: Measure your Snapchat ads from your store's visits and orders.
items.paymob: Cards, Meeza and wallets, paid to your own Paymob account.
items.product_feeds: A product link for Meta and Google catalog ads.
items.qr_codes: A QR code for your store, a page or a product.
items.shopify_import: Copy your products from a Shopify store.
items.size_chart: Shoppers see the size that fits them on the product page.
items.wassalha: Export your orders as a sheet for Wassalha's dashboard.

templates.title: Start from a design made for what you sell
templates.body: {count, plural, one {{count} ready template} other {{count} ready templates}}. Edit any section with Drag & Drop, and switch templates any time without losing your products.

pricing.title: Two simple plans, switch any time
pricing.body: Start free and pay a few cents per order, or go Pro for a flat monthly price.

faq.title: Questions before you start
faq.desc: Can't find your answer? <link>Message us on WhatsApp.</link>

items.q: What does an order cost on the free plan?
items.a: {orderFee} per order, with no monthly fee and no percentage of sales. Make a first top-up from {topUpMin} within {days} days to see your orders, send campaigns and keep your store online.
From about 1,000 orders a month, the flat {pro} costs less than per-order fees.
Yes. Choose your store's currency and the countries you ship to, and shoppers see prices in that currency.

items.q: Can I use my own domain?
items.a: Yes. Your store starts on yourbrand.tallaby.com, and you can connect a domain you own from Website › Domain.

items.q: Do I need to know how to code?
items.a: No. Design, products, payments and shipping are all set up from your dashboard.

final.title: Your store link is waiting
final.body: Claim it now. Design and publish whenever you're ready.
